runs.stopReason: The metadata guard rejected contentDetails.hasCustomThumbnail changing from false to true after the first custom-thumbnail upload. Read-only review found all other protected fields unchanged in these 8 records. No retry or rollback was performed.

receiptStorage.note: This aggregate file contains no private video IDs. Detailed receipts and old thumbnails are encrypted in each run's youtube-thumbnail-report artifact (3-day retention); downloaded ciphertext and private-key/decrypted records remain only on the original PC under .tmp/youtube-rollout. Never commit the private key or decrypted inventory. Use a new local key and fresh read-only inventory on another PC.

resumeGate: Review competitors and font treatments on the other PC, approve representative covers, correct and regression-test the hasCustomThumbnail guard, regenerate/review PNGs and their approval hashes, and create a new live inventory/plan before any further write. The old plan is not approval for a new font.
